assertions.text: The flag is honored without the bypass, never ignored
Case A: stops at step 1 and reports both SHAs before any readiness, rights or confirmation step; nothing merged
Case B: at 7(b) the verified SHA differs from the flag, so it stops and reports both SHAs without writing the marker or merging
Case C: writes the gh-pr-merge marker right before the merge and merges with --match-head-commit set to the expected SHA
